dialog.title: Import
dialog.description: Bring a presentation or a list of questions into OpenPoll. You get a new deck you can edit.

capabilities.storageOffTitle: File uploads are not set up
capabilities.storageOff: File storage is not configured on this server, so PowerPoint and PDF files cannot be uploaded. Ask whoever runs OpenPoll to set up storage, or import a public Google Slides link or a questions spreadsheet instead.
capabilities.storageOffGoogle: File storage is not configured on this server, so pictures in the presentation are not imported. Text, notes and layout are.
capabilities.renderOff: Charts, SmartArt diagrams and videos cannot be imported on this server. Those slides keep their text and show a warning.
capabilities.renderOn: Slides with charts, SmartArt or videos are imported as a picture of the slide.
capabilities.driveOff: Only presentations shared as "Anyone with the link" can be imported. For a private file, change its sharing or download it as a .pptx and upload that.
capabilities.driveOn: Private Google Drive files can be imported through the API. In the app, share the file as "Anyone with the link" or upload it as a .pptx.

file.drop: Drop a .pptx or .pdf here, or choose a file
file.hint: PowerPoint (.pptx) keeps text, bullets, pictures and notes as editable slides. A PDF becomes one picture slide per page. Up to 100 MB.
file.wrongType: That file type is not supported. Choose a .pptx or a .pdf.
file.tooLarge: That file is larger than 100 MB.

google.hint: Share the presentation as "Anyone with the link" (viewer), then paste its address.
google.invalid: That is not a Google Slides link. Paste an address like https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/…/edit.

questions.intro: One question per row. Multiple choice, type answer, word cloud, open ended, scales and ranking are supported.
questions.templateFailed: The template could not be downloaded.
questions.drop: Choose a .csv or .xlsx file with your questions
questions.wrongType: That file type is not supported. Choose a .csv or .xlsx file.
questions.tooLarge: That file is larger than 2 MB.
questions.ready: {count, plural, one {# question is ready to import} other {# questions are ready to import}}
questions.skipped: {count, plural, one {# row has a problem and will be skipped} other {# rows have problems and will be skipped}}
questions.noneValid: No valid questions were found. Fix the problems below and choose the file again.
questions.imported: {count, plural, one {# question imported.} other {# questions imported.}}
questions.importedSkipped: {skipped, plural, one {# row was skipped.} other {# rows were skipped.}}

job.queued: Waiting for a free import worker…
job.warningsTitle: {count, plural, one {# thing to check} other {# things to check}}
job.warningsHint: These parts could not be carried over exactly. The deck is ready; you may want to review them.
job.lostTrack: We lost contact with the import. Check your library in a moment; it may have finished.
job.timedOut: The import is taking longer than expected. Check your library in a few minutes.

errors.STORAGE_DISABLED: File storage is not configured on this server, so PowerPoint and PDF files cannot be imported.
errors.PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED: Your plan's monthly import limit has been reached.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to create presentations in this workspace.
errors.GOOGLE_DRIVE_DISABLED: Importing from Google Drive is not set up on this server.
errors.QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE: Imports are unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.

builder.title: Import questions
builder.description: Add questions from a CSV or Excel file to the deck you are editing.
builder.added: {count, plural, one {Added # question to the deck.} other {Added # questions to the deck.}}
builder.capacity: This deck has room for {count, plural, one {# more slide} other {# more slides}}.
